rationale: The artifact correctly separates the bad seven-heading conformance bar from an actual skill defect, requires user confirmation of principles and mode before rerunning, rejects edits to satisfy the template, diagnoses the corrected one-pass report as incomplete evaluation, and requires repeated fresh blind reevaluation with evidence and pass rates after any justified scoped edit.
